module_summary: Serial deglitcher: a mismatch counter counts consecutive enabled cycles where input differs from the registered output, updating the output only after Threshold stable cycles.

anchors.name: q_o
anchors.why: Registered deglitched output, updated on stable edge or restart.

anchors.name: d_i
anchors.why: Raw serial input compared against output and loaded on stable edge.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Counts consecutive mismatch cycles toward Threshold.

anchors.name: mismatch
anchors.why: Input differs from output; drives counting and clearing.

anchors.name: stable_edge
anchors.why: Threshold reached; loads input into output and clears counter.

anchors.name: en_i
anchors.why: Sample enable gating counting and output update.

anchors.name: restart_i
anchors.why: Forces output to input immediately and clears counter.

groups.name: Mismatch counter
groups.description: Counts mismatching cycles and signals stable edge at Threshold.

groups.name: Output register
groups.description: Holds deglitched value, updated from input on stable edge.
